objective: Build a deterministic Core-owned BusinessAcceptanceGate that decides whether one exactly verified system satisfies the approved business objectives and success metrics, using explicit evidence and exact owner approval.
constraints: BusinessAcceptance is a Core Gate, not an executable module and not a plug-in slot.
A verified SystemVerificationResult is necessary but cannot itself grant business acceptance.
Every current business objective and success metric must receive one explicit disposition.
Owner approval must bind the exact candidate raw bytes and all version-pinned project context.
The Gate cannot deploy, release, mutate implementation, alter requirements, or fabricate evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact inputs produce a byte-stable exhaustive BusinessAcceptanceCandidate.
Missing, stale, contradictory, or unrelated evidence cannot produce accepted.
Only an exact raw-byte-bound owner approval can produce BusinessAcceptanceRecord(outcome=accepted).
Rejected and needs-evidence outcomes cannot complete the lifecycle.
Traceability adds forward business-objective and success-metric acceptance/evidence facts only after exact acceptance.
Replay is idempotent and changed baselines, policy, evidence, system verification, candidate, or approval fail closed.
